newsitem.title: USA: J.C. Penney drug-store unit completes deal.
newsitem.headline: J.C. Penney drug-store unit completes deal.

text.p: J.C. Penney Co Inc said Friday its unit, Thrift Drug Inc, has completed its acquisition of Fay's Inc, a drug store chain.
The deal is valued at about $285 million in stock.
Each share of the Liverpool, N.Y.-based Fay's stock was converted into 0.2379286 shares of J.C. Penney common stock. Fay's will become a subsidiary of Thrift Drug.
The actual conversion ratio was based on the average daily price of J.C. Penney common stock of $53.5875 from September 25 to October 8, the company said.
Fay's stockholders will receive about 5.2 million shares of J.C. Penney common stock, and up to 412,500 shares reserved for exercises of stock options and other conversions, or about $285 million.
